breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to use both a 'gamma-centered k-point grid' and a 'half shift'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the mention of the half-shifted grid. The agent's generated specification repeated the contradictory instruction, stating 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift', thereby failing to resolve the conflict.
